review.notes: Full review. All seven findings of the previous review are repaired. Seeded sample: 15 targets (RD.2.12, RD.0.6, RD.1.28, RD.3.43, RD.6.57, RD.5.103, RD.0.14, RD.4.15, RD.0.49, RD.6.76, RD.1.32, RD.1.13, RD.1.30, RD.3.51, RD.0.31); 46 locators checked against 9 legal texts. RD.3.51's Berthelot preprint could not be read and is listed under Not verifiable. Gate: the worker's gate passes. My rerun against the default order fails only on the worker-moved UPWARD edge to CongruenceSpectralGap; the depcheck on the moved order reports 0 problems; the diff outside the folder is empty. Elaboration: 14 sorry warnings only; one-tactic probes fail on all 14 theorems; #check @ of all 18 declarations shows no lost binder. The RD.7.13(b) bound held in 882 random numerical cases. I resolved 153 cross-roadmap section-and-title citations: 3 cite the wrong title or section (R02, R03). The internal Needs graph has 1 forward cross-layer edge (R04) and no cycle. One P2: RD.3.43 is stated over noetherian schemes, beyond the finite-type domain of its objects and source.
